sources.name: Hugging Face Hub API
sources.fact: Official Hub API supports listing model and Space repositories; repository statistics must not be treated as commercial user counts.

sources.name: Hugging Face Spaces API
sources.fact: Gradio Spaces expose API endpoints; verify an individual Space before listing it as a usable consumer tool.

sources.name: OpenAI API Pricing
sources.fact: API token pricing differs by model and processing mode; not a ChatGPT consumer subscription quote.

sources.name: Gemini Developer API Pricing
sources.fact: Published API rates, free tiers, and availability are model/tier dependent and subject to change.
